tasks.goal: Add a platform-neutral ExecutionSupervisor interface and RuntimeHandle/ExecutionHandle schema under a new src/execution/ module. Define Start, Inspect, Attach, Stop, Collect and Destroy operations with context cancellation and error classification, a RuntimeHandle type whose authority is backendType plus a stable handle string (PID/PGID diagnostic only), an ExecutionStatus with desiredState and observedState, and a capability model covering descendant control, restart recovery, resource limits and filesystem/network isolation. Include a mock backend for tests. Do not migrate any existing process-tree or worker-lease code and do not add a launchd or Windows backend yet.
nonGoals: Do not refactor worker-lease or process-tree in this task.
Do not add launchd, Windows or sandbox backends.
deliverables: A mock backend and interface tests.
forbidden: Do not expose PID as the recovery authority.
Do not introduce a second process-tree abstraction.

tasks.goal: Migrate worker-lease recovery authority from the top-level PGID to a stable RuntimeHandle that records backend type and an exact identity handle, keeping PID/PGID diagnostic only. Preserve the exact-identity comparison, the identity-reuse vanished classification from the P2a fix, fail-closed behavior and the bounded durable registry. Add tests proving resume/recovery reads the RuntimeHandle, an identity-reused handle is never signalled and never treated as authority, and a truncated registry still returns needs_human. Do not change contract schema or add a launchd backend.
nonGoals: Do not weaken exact-identity or fail-closed safety.
Do not remove the P2a vanished classification.
Do not change contract schema in this task.
forbidden: Do not signal an identity-reused handle.
Do not let a reused PID become recovery authority.
Do not drop the bounded durable registry semantics.

tasks.goal: Add an execution.continuity field to TaskContract and Plan with fail-closed (default) and durable values, validate it in the contract schema, accept it through Plan compilation and Taskfile defaults, and wire it into supervisor start/resume so durable tasks re-attach by RuntimeHandle after controller restart while fail-closed tasks stop on lease expiry. Preserve legacy contracts as fail-closed. Add tests for validation, defaults, plan round-trip and resume behavior for both values. Do not add a launchd backend and do not change process cleanup semantics.
nonGoals: Do not default to durable for legacy contracts.
Do not change process-tree cleanup semantics.
deliverables: execution.continuity contract field with validation and defaults.
forbidden: Do not change legacy contracts to durable.
Do not conflate controller crash with user cancel.

tasks.goal: Add a runtime-conformance suite for the macOS process-group backend that proves cancellation and restart semantics. Cover: setsid escape leaves no residual; orphaned grandchildren after leader exit; closed output pipes; controller kill then re-attach by RuntimeHandle; an explicitly cancelled task is never rerun by restart; resource/cleanup of PTY, pipes, temp dirs and handles; and a parallel task is unaffected. Record capability limits honestly (process group is not full descendant-tree containment). Do not add launchd or Windows backends and do not weaken the identity-reuse safety.
nonGoals: Do not add launchd or Windows backends.
Do not run unbounded or real-provider fixtures.
deliverables: A conformance suite for the macOS process-group backend.
Cancel, restart, re-attach and cleanup fixtures.
forbidden: Do not signal by name or unverified identity.
Do not claim full descendant containment.
Do not depend on launchd in this slice.
